story.text: 오륙도 스카이워크 유리 바닥 아래로 새파란 바다가 훤히 내려다보인다. 발밑이 그대로 비쳐 보여 순간 '아찔하다'.
story.reading: o-ryuk-do seu-ka-i-wo-keu yu-ri ba-dak a-rae-ro sae-pa-ran ba-da-ga hwon-hi nae-ryeo-da-bo-in-da. bal-mit-i geu-dae-ro bi-chyeo bo-yeo sun-gan a-jjil-ha-da.
story.en: Below the glass floor of the Oryukdo Skywalk, the deep blue sea stretches out clearly beneath our feet. Seeing straight through to the water below, it's dizzying for a second.

story.text: "밑에 보이제? 나도 처음 왔을 때 다리 풀렸다. …아니, 지금 다리 풀리는 건 그것 때문이 아이고."
story.reading: mit-e bo-i-je? na-do cheo-eum wat-eul ttae da-ri pul-lyeot-da. …a-ni, ji-geum da-ri pul-li-neun geon geu-geot ttae-mun-i a-i-go.
story.en: "You can see straight down, right? My legs went weak the first time I came here too. …No, wait, the reason my legs are weak right now isn't because of that."

story.text: 그는 난간을 잡은 채 한참을 '머뭇거린다'. 하고 싶은 말이 있는 듯 입을 열었다 닫았다를 반복한다.
story.reading: geu-neun nan-gan-eul jab-eun chae han-cham-eul meo-mut-geo-rin-da. ha-go sip-eun mal-i it-neun deut ib-eul yeol-eot-da dad-at-da-reul ban-bok-han-da.
story.en: Gripping the railing, he hesitates for a long while. As if he has something he wants to say, he keeps opening and closing his mouth.

story.text: "크흠, 크흠." 괜히 '헛기침을' 두어 번 하더니 겨우 입을 뗀다. "저… 그, 니한테 할 말이 있는데."
story.reading: keu-heum, keu-heum. gwaen-hi heot-gi-chim-eul du-eo beon ha-deo-ni gyeo-u ib-eul ttem-da. jeo… geu, ni-han-te hal mal-i it-neun-de.
story.en: "Ahem, ahem." He clears his throat a couple of times for no reason before finally managing to speak. "So… um, there's something I need to tell you."

story.text: "이 말을 몇 번을 삼켰는지 모른다. 근데 오늘은 진짜 '입 밖에 내볼라고'."
story.reading: i mal-eul myeot beon-eul sam-kyeon-neun-ji mo-reun-da. geun-de o-neul-eun jin-jja ip bakk-e nae-bol-la-go.
story.en: "I don't know how many times I've swallowed this back down. But today I'm actually going to try and say it out loud."

story.text: 이마에 '진땀'까지 배어 나오는데, 정작 결정적인 순간에 말문이 턱 막힌다. "그, 그러니까 내 말은— 아, 진짜 이게 뭐라고 이래 안 나오노!"
story.reading: i-ma-e jin-ttam-kka-ji bae-eo na-o-neun-de, jeong-jak gyeol-jeong-jeok-in sun-gan-e mal-mun-i teok mak-hin-da. geu, geu-reo-ni-kka nae mal-eun— a, jin-jja i-ge mwo-ra-go i-rae an na-o-no!
story.en: Nervous sweat even starts beading on his forehead, but right at the crucial moment, the words get stuck in his throat. "So, what I mean is— ugh, seriously, why won't this come out no matter what!"

story.text: "됐다! 오늘은 몬 하겠다, 진짜! 다음에! 다음에 무조건 한다!" 그가 두 손으로 얼굴을 감싸며 그 자리에 주저앉는다.
story.reading: dwaet-da! o-neul-eun mon ha-get-da, jin-jja! da-eum-e! da-eum-e mu-jo-geon han-da! geu-ga du son-eu-ro eol-gul-eul gam-ssa-myeo geu ja-ri-e ju-jeo-anj-neun-da.
story.en: "Forget it! I can't do this today, seriously! Next time! I'm definitely doing it next time!" He buries his face in both hands and sinks right down on the spot.

story.text: "단어 다 봤제? 오늘 대화 문제도 집중해서 풀어봐라."
story.reading: dan-eo da bwat-je? o-neul dae-hwa mun-je-do jip-jung-hae-seo pul-eo-bwa-ra.
story.en: "Got a look at all the words? Focus and give today's conversation question a try too."

words.example_en: Looking down from up high made me dizzy.
He hesitated for a moment before answering.

words.meaning: A nervous or fake cough, throat-clearing
words.example_en: He clears his throat when he's nervous.

words.meaning: To say something out loud, voice a thought
words.example_en: I was afraid to say my true feelings out loud.
I was so nervous I broke into a nervous sweat.

sentences.ko: 높은 다리 위에서 아래를 보니 아찔했다.
sentences.reading: nop-eun da-ri wi-e-seo a-rae-reul bo-ni a-jjil-haet-da
sentences.en: Looking down from the high bridge made me dizzy.

sentences.ko: 그는 말을 꺼내기 전에 한참 머뭇거렸다.
sentences.reading: geu-neun mal-eul kkeo-nae-gi jeon-e han-cham meo-mut-geo-ryeot-da
sentences.en: He hesitated for a long while before bringing it up.
He clears his throat whenever things get awkward.

sentences.ko: 그 말을 입 밖에 내는 데 큰 용기가 필요했다.
sentences.reading: geu mal-eul ip bakk-e nae-neun de keun yong-gi-ga pil-yo-haet-da
sentences.en: It took a lot of courage to say those words out loud.
He was so nervous that his forehead broke out in sweat.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: What's wrong with you? Your face is bright red.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 아, 아니다! 여기 햇볕이 좀 강해가! …아니 사실 그게 아니고, 할 말이 있는데.
turns.reading: a, a-ni-da! yeo-gi haet-byeot-i jom gang-hae-ga! …a-ni sa-sil geu-ge a-ni-go, hal mal-i it-neun-de.
turns.en: N-no! The sun's just kind of strong here! …No wait, actually that's not it, there's something I want to say.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: What is it? Just say it, no need to be nervous.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 편하게 말하는 게 제일 안 되는 게 지금인데 어떡하노!
turns.reading: pyeon-ha-ge mal-ha-neun ge je-il an doe-neun ge ji-geum-in-de eo-tteok-ha-no!
turns.en: Right now is exactly when 'just saying it' is the hardest thing in the world, what am I supposed to do!

dialogues.question: 선우가 얼굴이 빨개진 진짜 이유는 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: What is the real reason Sunwoo's face turned red?
dialogues.correct_answer: 하고 싶은 말이 있어 긴장하고 있었기 때문에
options: 하고 싶은 말이 있어 긴장하고 있었기 때문에
dialogues.explanation: 선우는 햇볕 핑계를 대지만, 실제로는 하고 싶은 말을 꺼내려다 긴장해서 얼굴이 빨개진 것입니다.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.en: So, you… no wait, I mean…

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: You can take your time. There's no rush.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: …미안하다, 오늘은 진짜 안 되겠다. 심장이 터질 거 같아서 말이 하나도 안 나온다.
turns.reading: …mi-an-ha-da, o-neul-eun jin-jja an doe-get-da. sim-jang-i teo-jil geo gat-a-seo mal-i ha-na-do an na-on-da.
turns.en: …Sorry, I really can't do this today. My heart feels like it's about to burst, not a single word will come out.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: That's kind of cute, you like this.

dialogues.question: 이 대화에서 알 수 있는 선우의 모습은 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: What does this conversation show about Sunwoo?
dialogues.correct_answer: 진심을 전하려다 너무 긴장해서 결국 말을 잇지 못하는 모습
options: 진심을 전하려다 너무 긴장해서 결국 말을 잇지 못하는 모습
승객에게 화가 나서 말을 참는 모습
다른 생각을 하느라 정신이 없는 모습
dialogues.explanation: 선우는 진심을 전하려 여러 번 시도하지만, 너무 긴장한 나머지 결국 말을 끝맺지 못하고 포기합니다.
